data.value: select "stores"."area_code" as 'Area Code',"accounts"."id" as 'Code', "accounts"."name" as 'Name', "accounts"."father_name" as 'Father Name',"accounts"."cost" as 'Cast',"accounts"."id_card_no" as 'CNIC', "accounts"."phone" as 'Office Phone', "accounts"."home_phone" as 'Home Phone',"accounts"."balance" as 'Balance' from ("dbo"."accounts" "accounts" left join "dbo"."stores" "stores" on ("stores"."id" = "accounts"."store_id")) WHERE accounts.account_group_id='1002'

data.name: customSqlQuery9.Sql
data.value: SELECT rank() over(order by sti.item_id,items.name,sti.sale_rate) as 'Sr.No', sti.item_id as 'Code',items.name as 'Item',models.name as 'Model', items.cash_rate as 'Cash Rate', sti.sale_rate as 'Sale Rate', items.advance_rate as 'Advance', items.emi_price as 'Monthly EMI', CAST(ROUND(items.no_of_installments, 0) AS INT) as 'Installments', SUM(sti.stock_in - (sti.sold_out + sti.returned + sti.transfered)) as 'Stock',i_u.name as 'U.O.M' FROM stock_transaction_items as sti left join items on sti.item_id=items.id left join item_units as i_u on items.unit_id=i_u.id left join item_models as models on items.model_id=models.id WHERE ((sti.stock_in - (sti.sold_out + sti.returned + sti.transfered) ) > 0) and sti.store_id='501' GROUP BY sti.item_id,items.name, items.advance_rate, items.emi_price, items.cash_rate, items.no_of_installments,sti.sale_rate,i_u.name,models.name
